name: Jason Farrugia
headline: Head of BA & Solution Delivery, ANZ
about:
As the Head of BA & Solutions Delivery at Tryzens, I lead the ANZ solutions practice, specialising in defining, prioritising, and delivering customer-centric digital roadmaps that drive organisational alignment and deliver measurable results. I manage a talented team, ensuring effective mentorship, leadership, resourcing allocation, and guidance across projects. I also provide overall project-level support while representing the solution on steering committees to ensure the successful execution of high-impact digital projects.

I have had the privilege of working with leading brands such as Cotton On, R.M. Williams, Big W, Priceline, Poltix, Zimmermann, Bardot, Showpo, Macpac, and Treasury Wine Estates, delivering solutions on platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Magento. My approach focuses on building digital experiences that are purposeful and create lasting value for all stakeholders.

Prior to my role at Tryzens, as a Solution Strategist at Amblique, I led and delivered eCommerce projects on Salesforce Commerce Cloud for clients including SONY, Jets Swimwear, SurfStitch, Review, and Super Retail Group (RAYS, BCF, rebel, Supercheap Auto). I also managed the Oroton re-platform to BigCommerce and supported key clients such as 2XU, Brandbank (Seed, Nine West, French Connection), Michael Hill, R.M. Williams, and Rodd & Gunn.

Earlier in my career as a QA Team Lead, I managed front-end testing and custom WordPress development for some of our largest clients, refining my skills in project management and quality assurance, which laid a strong foundation for my career in digital solutions and e-commerce.

experiences.description: As part of my role As a Solution Strategist, I lead and deliver discovery workshops, scoping, design, development and testing phases. Within these phases, I work closely with the client, internal stakeholders, design team and developers/testers to provide superior projects to meet the clients business requirements.

I was responsible for creating detailed functional specification documents that define clients’ key requirements. I work with clients and colleagues throughout the project lifecycle, from discovery and design to development and testing.

This role has allowed me to develop my skill set from the technical focus I had as a junior digital producer to more of a client focus. I am now skilled in building strong client relationships, managing schedules, invoicing, managing mini projects, providing expert advice and ensuring each task was delivered and deployed on time.

As Team Lead, I am responsible for managing team members in Australia and India. My biggest priority is our major client. This role has allowed me to develop my skill set from the technical focus I had as a QA Analyst. I am now skilled in building strong client relationships, managing schedules, creating new tools, providing expert advice and leading a successful and cohesive team.
